Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَ أَوَّلُ مُعْتَرِفٍ مِّنَ الطِّيْنِ بِرُبُوْبِيَّتِكَ
Translation: And the first from clay to acknowledge Your Lordship
And the beginning of Your proof upon Your servants and Your creation

Arabic text: وَالدَّلِيْلُ عَلَى الْاِسْتِجَارَةِ بِعَفْوِكَ مِنْ عُقُوْبَتِكَ
Translation: And the guide to seeking refuge in Your forgiveness from Your punishment
And the one who established the paths of Your repentance

Arabic text: وَ الْمُوَسَّلُ بَيْنَ الْخَلْقِ وَ بَيْنَ مَعْرِفَتِكَ
Translation: And the mediator between creation and knowledge of You

Arabic text: وَ الَّذِيْ لَقَّنْتَهُ مَا رَضَيْتَ بِهِ عَنْهُ بِمَنِّكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ رَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: And the one whom You taught what pleased You through Your favor and mercy upon him

Arabic text: وَ الْمُنِيْبُ الَّذِيْ لَمْ يُصِرَّ عَلٰى مَعْصِيَتِكَ
Translation: And the penitent who did not persist in disobeying You

Arabic text: وَ سَابِقُ الْمُتَذَلِّلِيْنَ بِحَلْقِ رَأْسِهِ فِيْ حَرَمِكَ
Translation: And the foremost among the humble ones by shaving his head in Your sanctuary

Arabic text: وَ الْمُتَوَسِّلُ بَعْدَ الْمَعْصِيَةِ بِالطَّاعَةِ اِلٰى عَفْوِكَ
Translation: And the one who sought means after sin through obedience to Your forgiveness

Arabic text: وَ أَبُوْ الْاَنْبِيَاءِ الَّذِيْنَ اُوْذُوْا فِيْ جَنْبِكَ
Translation: And the father of prophets who were harmed for Your sake

Arabic text: وَ اَكْثَرُ سُكَّانِ الْاَرْضِ سَعْيًا فِيْ طَاعَتِكَ
Translation: And the most striving among the inhabitants of earth in Your obedience

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ اَنْتَ يَا رَحْمٰنُ وَ مَلَائِكَتُكَ وَ سُكَّانُ سَمٰوَاتِكَ وَ أَرْضِكَ كَمَا
Translation: So send blessings upon him, O Most Merciful, and Your angels and the inhabitants of Your heavens and earth as he
And guide us to the path of Your pleasure
O Most Merciful of those who show mercy
